measurement: At each settled Binance BTCUSDT perpetual funding event, multiply continuous negative-funding extremeness by the ratio of trailing 24-hour to trailing 168-hour realized mark-price volatility; compute only after the funding record and all required closed hourly mark-price bars are available.
formula: Let f_t be the settled fundingRate at t and let mu90_t and sd90_t be the mean and sample standard deviation of the 90 immediately preceding settled 8-hour funding rates, excluding f_t. neg_extreme_t=max(0,-((f_t-mu90_t)/sd90_t)). For closed hourly mark-price log returns r_i ending no later than t, sigma24_t=sqrt(mean(r_i^2 over the latest 24 returns)) and sigma168_t=sqrt(mean(r_i^2 over the latest 168 returns)). value_t=neg_extreme_t*(sigma24_t/sigma168_t). Reject observations when sd90_t<=0, sigma168_t<=0, a required bar is missing, or source timestamps are non-monotonic.
data_source: Official Binance USD-M Futures public REST endpoints GET /fapi/v1/fundingRate and GET /fapi/v1/markPriceKlines for BTCUSDT; preserve fundingTime, kline open/close times, collector receipt time as available_at, raw responses, request parameters, and SHA-256 hashes.
